caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object situated in the center of a light, beige-toned background. The object consists of a flat, rectangular plate supported by four rods that form its frame, two of which extend upward ending in curved, pointed hooks, while the other two extend outward horizontally, also curling at the ends into hooks or loops. The entire object has a monochromatic, steel-gray coloration with shading that gives it a three-dimensional appearance. The drawing style is realistic, with clear attention to detail in the depiction of the object's metallic texture and geometric form. There are no other objects or patterns present in the composition. The artist’s name, “Gordon Sansborn,” is written in small text in the lower left corner.
title: Fender Plate Warmer
